description.en: The resource specifications for project namespaces.

descriptions.zh: **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解Flink全托管产品的收费方式和[价格](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/flink/product-overview/switch-from-pay-as-you-go-to-subscription)。**
descriptions.en: **Before you use this API, make sure that you fully understand the billing model and [pricing](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/flink/product-overview/switch-from-pay-as-you-go-to-subscription) of Alibaba Cloud Fully Managed Flink.**

example.unifiedCli: aliyun foasconsole convert-instance --biz-region cn-beijing --instance-id f-cn-wwo36qj4g06 --pricing-cycle Month --duration 1 --is-auto-renew true --namespace-resource-specs '[{"ResourceSpec":{"Cpu":1,"MemoryGB":4},"Namespace":"ns-1"}]' --use-promotion-code true --promotion-code example-string --api-version 2021-10-28 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun foasconsole ConvertInstance --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'f-cn-wwo36qj4g06' --PricingCycle Month --PromotionCode 'example-string' --Region 'cn-beijing' --Duration 1 --IsAutoRenew true --NamespaceResourceSpecs '[{"ResourceSpec":{"Cpu":1,"MemoryGB":4},"Namespace":"ns-1"}]' --UsePromotionCode true
